post.description:
Import tracker data.
Tracker data is imported asynchronously by default (as with `async=true`). Asynchronous imports get a `WebMessage` response with a URL to the job executing the import. Check the job status by following the `response.location` URL. Set `async=true` to import synchronously in which case the response will be the `ImportReport`. Prefer asynchronous imports for large data sets.

EnrollmentRequestParams.order.name: order
EnrollmentRequestParams.order.description:
`<propertyName1:sortDirection>[,<propertyName2:sortDirection>...]`  
  
Get enrollments in given order. Enrollments can be ordered by the following case-sensitive  
properties  
  
* `completedAt`  
* `createdAt`  
* `createdAtClient`  
* `enrolledAt`  
* `updatedAt`  
* `updatedAtClient`  
  
Valid `sortDirection`s are `asc` and `desc`. `sortDirection` is case-insensitive. `sortDirection`  
defaults to `asc` for properties without explicit `sortDirection` as in `order=enrolledAt`.  
  
Enrollments are ordered by newest (internal id desc) by default meaning when no `order` parameter is  
provided.

EnrollmentRequestParams.orgUnitMode.name: orgUnitMode
EnrollmentRequestParams.orgUnitMode.description:
Get enrollments using given organisation unit selection mode.  
  
- When `orgUnitMode=SELECTED`, `orgUnitMode=CHILDREN` or `orgUnitMode=DESCENDANTS`, the `orgUnit`  
  parameter is  
  required to specify which enrollments to return.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ALL` enrollments will be downloaded irrespective of the organization unit they  
  are  
  owned by. To use this parameter, the user needs the `Search Tracked entity in all org units`  
  authority.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ACCESSIBLE` enrollments owned by any org unit in the users capture scope will be  
  returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=CAPTURE` enrollments that has an enrollment org unit in the users capture scope  
  will  
  be returned.

EnrollmentRequestParams.orgUnits.name: orgUnits
EnrollmentRequestParams.orgUnits.description:
`<orgUnit1-uid>[,<orgUnit2-uid>...]`  
  
Get enrollments owned by given `orgUnits` relative to the `orgUnitMode`.  
  
- When `orgUnitMode=SELECTED` - or no `orgUnitMode` is given (default) - the enrollments owned by  
  the `orgUnits` are returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=CHILDREN` the enrollments owned by the `orgUnits` or by the `orgUnits` direct  
  children is returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=DESCENDANTS` the enrollments owned by the `orgUnits` or any of its descendants  
  are returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ALL`, `orgUnitMode=CAPTURE` or `orgUnitMode=ACCESSIBLE` the `orgUnits` parameter  
  is not allowed.

EventRequestParams.filter.name: filter
EventRequestParams.filter.description:
`<filter1>[,<filter2>...]`  
  
Get events matching the given filters on data values. A filter is a colon separated data element UID  
with optional operator and value pairs.   
  
We differentiate between two types of operators: unary and   
binary. Unary operators don't require a value, while binary operators do.  
- Unary: `filter=H9IlTX2X6SL:null`  
- Binary: `filter=H9IlTX2X6SL:sw:A`   
  
Special characters like `+` must be percent-encoded (`%2B` instead of `+`). Characters like `:` and  
`,` in filter values must be escaped with `/`. Likewise, `/` needs to be escaped.  
Multiple operators are allowed for the same data element, e.g.,  
`filter=AuPLng5hLbE:gt:438901703:lt:448901704`. Operators and values are  
case-insensitive. A user needs metadata read access to the data element and data read access to the  
program (if the program is without registration) or the program stage (if the program is with  
registration).  
  
All of the following operators are supported regardless of the value type. Values are compared using  
text comparison unless stated otherwise. Integer and decimal value types are treated as Postgres  
integer and numeric data types for the specified operators.  
  
Valid binary operators are:  
- `eq` - equal to (uses integer/numeric semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ieq` - equal to  
- `ge` - greater than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `gt` - greater than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `le` - less than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `lt` - less than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ne` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `neq` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `nieq` - not equal to  
- `in` - equal to one of the multiple values separated by semicolon ";" (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ilike` - is like  
- `like` - like (free text match)  
- `nilike` - not like  
- `nlike` - not like  
- `sw` - starts with  
- `ew` - ends with  
  
Right now all matches are case-insensitive so for example `eq` and `ieq` (`i` for `insensitive`)  
behave in the same way.  
  
Valid unary operators are:  
- `null` - has no value  
- `!null` - has a value

EventRequestParams.filterAttributes.name: filterAttributes
EventRequestParams.filterAttributes.description:
`<filter1>[,<filter2>...]`  
  
Get events matching the given filters on tracked entity attributes. A filter is a colon separated   
attribute UID with optional operator and value pairs.   
  
We differentiate between two types of  
operators: unary and binary. Unary operators don't require a value, while binary operators do.  
- Unary: `filterAttributes=H9IlTX2X6SL:null`  
- Binary: `filterAttributes=H9IlTX2X6SL:sw:A`

Valid binary operators are:  
- `eq` - equal to (uses integer/numeric semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ieq` - equal to  
- `ge` - greater than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `gt` - greater than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `le` - less than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `lt` - less than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ne` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `neq` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `nieq` - not equal to  
- `in` - equal to one of the multiple values separated by semicolon ";" (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ilike` - is like  
- `like` - like (free text match)  
- `nilike` - not like  
- `nlike` - not like  
- `sw` - starts with  
- `ew` - ends with  
  
Right now all matches are case-insensitive so for example `eq` and `ieq` (`i` for `insensitive`)  
behave in the same way.  
  
Valid unary operators are:

- `!null` - has a value

EventRequestParams.order.name: order
EventRequestParams.order.description:
`<propertyName1:sortDirection>[,<propertyName2:sortDirection>...]`  
  
Get events in given order. Events can be ordered by data elements and tracked entity attributes by  
passing a UID instead of a property name. This will order events by the values of the specified  
attribute and data element not their UIDs. Events can also be ordered by the following  
case-sensitive properties  
  
* `assignedUser`  
* `assignedUserDisplayName`  
* `attributeOptionCombo`  
* `completedAt`  
* `completedBy`  
* `createdAt`  
* `createdAtClient`  
* `createdBy`  
* `deleted`  
* `enrolledAt`  
* `enrollment`  
* `enrollmentStatus`  
* `event`  
* `followUp`  
* `occurredAt`  
* `orgUnit`  
* `program`  
* `programStage`  
* `scheduledAt`  
* `status`  
* `storedBy`  
* `trackedEntity`  
* `updatedAt`  
* `updatedAtClient`  
* `updatedBy`  
  
Valid `sortDirection`s are `asc` and `desc`. `sortDirection` is case-insensitive. `sortDirection`  
defaults to `asc` for properties or UIDs without explicit `sortDirection` as in `order=scheduledAt`.  
  
Events are ordered by newest (internal id desc) by default meaning when no `order` parameter is  
provided.

EventRequestParams.orgUnitMode.name: orgUnitMode
EventRequestParams.orgUnitMode.description: Get events using given organisation unit mode.

EventRequestParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
EventRequestParams.pageSize.description: Get given number of items per page.

EventRequestParams.paging.name: paging
EventRequestParams.paging.description:
Get all items by specifying `paging=false`. Requests are paginated by default.

**Be aware that the performance is directly related to the amount of data requested. Larger pages
will take more time to return.**

EventRequestParams.programStatus.name: programStatus
EventRequestParams.programStatus.description:
Get events from an enrollment in the given status.  
  
**DEPRECATED as of 2.42:** Use parameter `enrollmentStatus` instead.  
  
See `enrollmentStatus` for details.

EventRequestParams.scheduledAfter.name: scheduledAfter
EventRequestParams.scheduledAfter.description:
Get events that are scheduled after given date and time.  
This parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included in the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the start of the day is assumed.

EventRequestParams.scheduledBefore.name: scheduledBefore
EventRequestParams.scheduledBefore.description:
Get events that are scheduled before given date and time.  
This parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included in the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the end of the day is assumed.

EventRequestParams.totalPages.name: totalPages
EventRequestParams.totalPages.description:
Get the total number of items and pages in the pager.

**Only enable this if absolutely necessary as this is resource intensive.** Use the pagers
`prev/nextPage` to determine if there is a previous or a next page instead.

EventRequestParams.trackedEntity.name: trackedEntity
EventRequestParams.trackedEntity.description: Get events of tracked entity with given UID.

EventRequestParams.updatedAfter.name: updatedAfter
EventRequestParams.updatedAfter.description:
Get events updated after given date and time.  
This parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included in the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the start of the day is assumed.

EventRequestParams.updatedBefore.name: updatedBefore
EventRequestParams.updatedBefore.description:
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the end of the day is assumed.

EventRequestParams.updatedWithin.name: updatedWithin
EventRequestParams.updatedWithin.description: Get events updated since given ISO-8601 duration.

GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.da.name: dataSet
GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.da.description: When set the operands linked to the specified dataset are the basis for the result list.

GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.pe.name: persisted
GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.pe.description: When set all existing operands are the basis of the result list (takes precedence).

GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.to.name: totals
GetDataElementOperandObjectListParams.to.description: Whether to include totals when loading operands by `dataSet` or data element groups from `filter`s.

GetMessageConversationObjectListParams.q.name: queryOperator
GetMessageConversationObjectListParams.q.description: The operator used when using the `queryString` filter (default is `token`)

GetMessageConversationObjectListParams.q.name: queryString
GetMessageConversationObjectListParams.q.description: Adds a _fuzzy_ search filter for the query term in subject, message text or sender name

GetObjectListParams.filter.name: filter
GetObjectListParams.filter.description:
Filter results using `filter={property}:{operator}[:{value}]` expressions as described in detail in
  [Metadata-object-filter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata.html#webapi_metadata_object_filter).

GetObjectListParams.order.name: order
GetObjectListParams.order.description:
Adds ordering to the result list.
Case-sensitive: `{property}:asc`, `{property}:desc`
Case-insensitive: `{property}:iasc`, `{property}:idesc`
Only supports properties that are both persisted and simple.

GetObjectListParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
GetObjectListParams.pageSize.description: The maximum number of elements on a page.

GetObjectListParams.paging.name: paging
GetObjectListParams.paging.description: Use paging controlled by `page` and `pageSize` or return all matches (use with caution).

GetObjectListParams.query.name: query
GetObjectListParams.query.description:
Adds a filter equivalent to the following three `filter`s combined _OR_ (independent of `rootJunction`):
`id:eq:{query}`, `code:eq:{query}`, `name:like:{query}`. Can be used in addition to regular `filter`s.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.leve.name: level
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.leve.description:
Limits results to organisation units on the given level (absolute starting with 1 for the root).
When used for list relative to a parent this is the level relative to the parent level where `level=1` are
all direct children of the parent.
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `withinUser*`/`userOnly*` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.leve.name: levelSorted
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.leve.description: Shorthand equivalent for the URL parameter `order=level:asc`.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.maxL.name: maxLevel
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.maxL.description:
Limits results to organisation units on the given level or above (absolute starting with 1 for the root).
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `withinUser*`/`userOnly*` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.memb.name: memberCollection
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.memb.description:
Name of the organisation unit collection property to use when checking of the `memberObject` is a member.
For example, `groups`, `dataSets`, `programs`, `users`, `categoryOptions`.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.memb.name: memberObject
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.memb.description:
When set for each organisation unit in the result list a count is added as property `memberCount`.
This count is the number of organisation units in the unit's subtree (including itself) where
the `memberObject` is a member of the relation defined by the `memberCollection` property.
Use with caution, as this is an expensive operation.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.name: userDataViewFallback
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.description:
Limits result to organisation units that are explicitly listed in the current user's data view set (excluding any non-listed children)
with fallback to the user's data capture set if the data view set is empty.
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.name: userDataViewOnly
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.description:
Limits result to organisation units that are explicitly listed in the current user's data view set (excluding any non-listed children).
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.name: userOnly
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.user.description:
Limits result to organisation units that are explicitly listed in the current user's data capture set (excluding any non-listed children).
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.name: withinDataViewUserHierarchy
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.description:
Limits result to organisation units for which the current user has data view privileges.
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.name: withinUserHierarchy
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.description:
Limits result to organisation units for which current user has data capture privileges.
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.name: withinUserSearchHierarchy
GetOrganisationUnitObjectListParams.with.description:
Limits result to organisation units for which the current user has search privileges.
Can be combined with further `filter`s and/or one of the `level`/`maxLevel` limitations.

GetProgramObjectListParams.userFilter.name: userFilter
GetProgramObjectListParams.userFilter.description: Limit the results to programs accessible to the current user based on data sharing read access instead of metadata sharing read access.

GetTrackedEntityAttributeObjectListParam.name: indexableOnly
GetTrackedEntityAttributeObjectListParam.description:
Limits the results to searchable attributes of type `TEXT`, `LONG_TEXT`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `EMAIL`, `USERNAME`, `URL`
as well as unique attributes. Can be combined with further `filter`s.

GetUserObjectListParams.authSubset.name: authSubset
GetUserObjectListParams.authSubset.description: Limits result to users that have no authority the current user doesn't have as well.

GetUserObjectListParams.canManage.name: canManage
GetUserObjectListParams.canManage.description: Limits results to users that are members of a group the current user can manage.

GetUserObjectListParams.inactiveMonths.name: inactiveMonths
GetUserObjectListParams.inactiveMonths.description: Limits results to users that haven't logged in for at least this number of months.

GetUserObjectListParams.inactiveSince.name: inactiveSince
GetUserObjectListParams.inactiveSince.description: Limits results to users that haven't logged in since this date(-time) (shorthand for `filter=lastLogin:lt:{date}`).

GetUserObjectListParams.invitationStatus.name: invitationStatus
GetUserObjectListParams.invitationStatus.description:
Limits results to users that with the provided invitation status
(`ALL` equals `filter=invitation:eq:true`, `EXPIRED` also requires the invitation to have expired by now).

GetUserObjectListParams.lastLogin.name: lastLogin
GetUserObjectListParams.lastLogin.description: Limits results to users that were logged in on or after the given date(-time) (shorthand for `filter=lastLogin:ge:{date}`).

GetUserObjectListParams.manage.name: manage
GetUserObjectListParams.manage.description: Shorthand for `canManage=true` + `authSubset=true` (takes precedence over individual parameters)

GetUserObjectListParams.orgUnitBoundary.name: orgUnitBoundary
GetUserObjectListParams.orgUnitBoundary.description:
Limits results to users that have a common organisation unit connection with the current user.
The `orgUnitBoundary` determines if the data capture, data view or search sets are considered.
When `includeChildren=true` is used the comparison includes the subtree of all units in the compared set.

GetUserObjectListParams.ou.name: ou
GetUserObjectListParams.ou.description:
Limits results to users that have data capture connection to the given organisation unit.
The compared set can be changed using `orgUnitBoundary`.

GetUserObjectListParams.phoneNumber.name: phoneNumber
GetUserObjectListParams.phoneNumber.description: Limits results to users with the given phone number (shorthand for `filter=phoneNumber:eq:{value}`)

GetUserObjectListParams.selfRegistered.name: selfRegistered
GetUserObjectListParams.selfRegistered.description: Limits results to users that have self registered (shorthand for `filter=selfRegistered:eq:true`)

GetUserRoleObjectListParams.canIssue.name: canIssue
GetUserRoleObjectListParams.canIssue.description:
Limits results to those roles that the current user can issue/grant to other users.
Can be combined with further `filter`s.

GetValidationRuleObjectListParams.dataSe.name: dataSet
GetValidationRuleObjectListParams.dataSe.description:
Limits results to validation rules that are connected to the given dataset.
Can be combined with further `filter`s.

GistParams.absoluteUrls.name: absoluteUrls
GistParams.absoluteUrls.description:
Use absolute (`true`) or relative URLs (`false`, default) when linking to other objects in `apiEndpoints`.
See [Gist absoluteUrls parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_absoluteUrls).

GistParams.auto.name: auto
GistParams.auto.description:
The extent of fields to include when no specific list of fields is provided using `fields` so that  that listed fields are automatically determined.
See [Gist auto parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#the-auto-parameter).

GistParams.describe.name: describe
GistParams.describe.description: When `true` the query is not executed but the planned execution is described back similar to using _describe_ in SQL/database context.

GistParams.filter.name: filter
GistParams.filter.description:
A comma seperated list of filters.
See [Gist filter parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_filter).

GistParams.headless.name: headless
GistParams.headless.description:
Endpoints returning a list by default wrap the items with an envelope containing the pager and the list, which is named according to the type of object listed.
See [Gist headless parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_headless).

GistParams.inverse.name: inverse
GistParams.inverse.description:
Inverse can be used in context of a collection field gist of the form /api/<object-type>/<object-id>/<field-name>/gist to not list all items that are contained in the member collection but all items that are not contained in the member collection.
See [Gist inverse parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#the-inverse-parameter).

GistParams.locale.name: locale
GistParams.locale.description:
Switch translation language of display names. If not specified the translation language is the one configured in the users account settings.
See [Gist locale parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_locale).

GistParams.order.name: order
GistParams.order.description:
To sort the list of items - one or more order expressions can be given.
See [Gist order parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_order).

GistParams.orgUnitsOffline.name: orgUnitsOffline
GistParams.orgUnitsOffline.description:
When true, the list is adjusted for efficient listing of organisation units for offline caching.
Most importantly the list will not have paging (not possible otherwise).
Overrides `fields` with the equivalent of `fields=path,displayName,children::isNotEmpty`.
Overrides `references` with `references=false`.

GistParams.orgUnitsTree.name: orgUnitsTree
GistParams.orgUnitsTree.description:
When true, the list is adjusted for efficient paged listing of organisation units displaying search results as tree.
Overrides `order` with the equivalent of `order=path`.
Overrides `references` with `references=false`.
Always adds `path` to the `fields` list, if not already contained.
For organisation units `/api/organisationUnits/gist` lists all parents up to the root (ancestors) of any match are included in the result list.
In that case a boolean property `match` is added to each entry indicating if the entry was added as ancestor (`false`) or as query match (`true`)

GistParams.page.name: page
GistParams.page.description:
The viewed page in paged list starting with 1 for the first page
See [Gist page parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_page).

GistParams.pageListName.name: pageListName
GistParams.pageListName.description: The name of the property in the response object that holds the list of response objects when a paged response is used.

GistParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
GistParams.pageSize.description:
The number of items on a page. Maximum is 1000 items.
See [Gist pageSize parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_pageSize).

GistParams.references.name: references
GistParams.references.description: By default, the Gist API includes links to referenced objects. This can be disabled by using `references=false`.

GistParams.rootJunction.name: rootJunction
GistParams.rootJunction.description:
Combine `filter`s with `AND` (default) or `OR` logic combinator
See [Gist rootJunction parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_rootJunction).

GistParams.totalPages.name: totalPages
GistParams.totalPages.description:
By default, a gist query will not count the total number of matches should those exceed the `pageSize` limit.
Using `totalPages=true` the pager includes the total number of matches.
See [Gist total parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_total).

GistParams.translate.name: translate
GistParams.translate.description:
Fields like _name_ or _shortName_ can be translated (internationalised).
By default, any translatable field that has a translation is returned translated given that the user requesting the gist has an interface language configured.
To return the plain non-translated field use `translate=false`.
See [Gist translate parameter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata-gist.html#gist_parameters_translate).

MetadataImportParams.async.name: async
MetadataImportParams.async.description: Asynchronous import, returns immediately with a _Location_ header pointing to the location of the _importReport_. The payload also contains a json object of the job created.

MetadataImportParams.atomicMode.name: atomicMode
MetadataImportParams.atomicMode.description: Sets atomic mode, in the old importer we always did a best effort import, which means that even if some references did not exist, we would still import (i.e. missing data elements on a data element group import). Default for new importer is to not allow this, and similar reject any validation errors. Setting the `NONE` mode emulated the old behavior.

MetadataImportParams.flushMode.name: flushMode
MetadataImportParams.flushMode.description: Sets the flush mode, which controls when to flush the internal cache. It is strongly recommended to keep this to `AUTO` (which is the default). Only use `OBJECT` for debugging purposes, where you are seeing hibernate exceptions and want to pinpoint the exact place where the stack happens (hibernate will only throw when flushing, so it can be hard to know which object had issues).

MetadataImportParams.identifier.name: identifier
MetadataImportParams.identifier.description: Sets the identifier scheme to use for reference matching. `AUTO` means try `UID` first, then `CODE`.

MetadataImportParams.importMode.name: importMode
MetadataImportParams.importMode.description: Sets overall import mode, decides whether or not to only `VALIDATE` or also `COMMIT` the metadata, this has similar functionality as our old dryRun flag.

MetadataImportParams.importReportMode.name: importReportMode
MetadataImportParams.importReportMode.description: Sets the `ImportReport` mode, controls how much is reported back after the import is done. `ERRORS` only includes ObjectReports for object which has errors. `FULL` returns an ObjectReport for all objects imported, and `DEBUG` returns the same plus a name for the object (if available).

MetadataImportParams.importStrategy.name: importStrategy
MetadataImportParams.importStrategy.description: Sets import strategy, `CREATE_AND_UPDATE` will try and match on identifier, if it doesn't exist, it will create the object.

MetadataImportParams.preheatMode.name: preheatMode
MetadataImportParams.preheatMode.description: Sets the preheater mode, used to signal if preheating should be done for `ALL` (as it was before with `preheatCache=true`) or do a more intelligent scan of the objects to see what to preheat (now the default), setting this to `NONE` is not recommended.

MetadataImportParams.skipSharing.name: skipSharing
MetadataImportParams.skipSharing.description: Skip sharing properties, does not merge sharing when doing updates, and does not add user group access when creating new objects.

OpenApiGenerationParams.expandedRefs.name: expandedRefs
OpenApiGenerationParams.expandedRefs.description:
Annotations that narrow the rendered type to one of the super-types of the type declared will be ignored
and as a consequence types occur fully expanded (with all their properties).
Note that this does not affect types that are re-defined as a different type using annotations.

OpenApiGenerationParams.failOnInconsiste.name: failOnInconsistency
OpenApiGenerationParams.failOnInconsiste.description:
Declarations can be logically inconsistent; for example a parameter that is both required and has a default value.
Either this is ignored and only logs a warning (`false`) or the generation fails (`true`)

OpenApiGenerationParams.failOnNameClash.name: failOnNameClash
OpenApiGenerationParams.failOnNameClash.description:
Shared schema names must be unique.
To ensure this either a unique name is picked (`false`) or the generation fails (`true`)

OpenApiGenerationParams.includeXProperti.name: includeXProperties
OpenApiGenerationParams.includeXProperti.description:
Set `true` to include non-standard OpenAPI properties supported by DHIS2
(excluding `x-classifiers` which is switched separately by `includeXClassifiers`)

OpenApiGenerationParams.skipCache.name: skipCache
OpenApiGenerationParams.skipCache.description:
Regenerate the response even if a cached response is available.
Mainly used during development to see effects of hot-swap code changes.

OpenApiRenderingParams.inlineEnumsLimit.name: inlineEnumsLimit
OpenApiRenderingParams.inlineEnumsLimit.description:
Values of a shared enum with less than the limit values will show the first n values up to limit
directly where the type is used

OpenApiRenderingParams.source.name: source
OpenApiRenderingParams.source.description: Include the JSON source in the operations and schemas (for debug purposes)

OpenApiScopingParams.scope.name: scope
OpenApiScopingParams.scope.description: When given only operations in controllers matching the scope are considered

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.fields.name: fields
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.fields.description:
Get only the given fields in the JSON response. This query parameter allows you to remove
unnecessary fields from the JSON response and in some cases decrease the response time. Refer to
[metadata field filter](https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata.html#webapi_metadata_field_filter)
on how to use it.

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.order.name: order
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.order.description:
`<propertyName1:sortDirection>[,<propertyName2:sortDirection>...]`

Get potential duplicates in given order.

Valid `sortDirection`s are `asc` and `desc`. `sortDirection` is case-insensitive.

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.pageSize.description: Get given number of items per page.

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.paging.name: paging
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.paging.description:
Get all items by specifying `paging=false`. Requests are paginated by default.

**Be aware that the performance is directly related to the amount of data requested. Larger pages
will take more time to return.**

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.status.name: status
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.status.description: Get potential duplicates that are in given status.

PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.trackedE.name: trackedEntities
PotentialDuplicateRequestParams.trackedE.description:
`<uid1>[,<uid2>...]`

Get potential duplicates for given tracked entities.

ProgramMessageRequestParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
ProgramMessageRequestParams.pageSize.description: Get given number of items per page.

ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.name: pageSize
ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.description: Get given number of items per page.

ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.name: paging
ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.description:
Get all items by specifying `paging=false`. Requests are paginated by default.

**Be aware that the performance is directly related to the amount of data requested. Larger pages
will take more time to return.**

ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.name: totalPages
ProgramNotificationInstanceRequestParams.description:
Get the total number of items and pages in the pager.

**Only enable this if absolutely necessary as this is resource intensive.** Use the pagers
`prev/nextPage` to determine if there is a previous or a next page instead.

RelationshipRequestParams.enrollment.name: enrollment
RelationshipRequestParams.enrollment.description: Get the relationships of the given enrollment.

RelationshipRequestParams.event.name: event
RelationshipRequestParams.event.description: Get relationships of the given event.

RelationshipRequestParams.fields.name: fields
RelationshipRequestParams.fields.description:
Get only the specified fields in the JSON response. This query parameter allows you to remove  
unnecessary fields from  
the JSON response and in some cases decrease the response time. Refer to  
https://docs.dhis2.org/en/develop/using-the-api/dhis-core-version-master/metadata.html#webapi_metadata_field_filter  
for how to use it.

RelationshipRequestParams.includeDeleted.name: includeDeleted
RelationshipRequestParams.includeDeleted.description: Get soft-deleted relationships by specifying `includeDeleted=true`. Soft-deleted relationships are excluded by default.

RelationshipRequestParams.order.name: order
RelationshipRequestParams.order.description:
`<propertyName1:sortDirection>[,<propertyName2:sortDirection>...]`  
  
Get relationships in given order. Relationships can be ordered by the following case-sensitive  
properties  
  
* `createdAt`  
* `createdAtClient`  
  
Valid `sortDirection`s are `asc` and `desc`. `sortDirection` is case-insensitive. `sortDirection`  
defaults to `asc` for properties without explicit `sortDirection` as in `order=createdAt`.  
  
Relationships are ordered by newest (internal id desc) by default meaning when no `order` parameter  
is provided.

RelationshipRequestParams.pageSize.name: pageSize
RelationshipRequestParams.pageSize.description: Get given number of items per page.

RelationshipRequestParams.paging.name: paging
RelationshipRequestParams.paging.description:
Get all items by specifying `paging=false`. Requests are paginated by default.

**Be aware that the performance is directly related to the amount of data requested. Larger pages
will take more time to return.**

RelationshipRequestParams.totalPages.name: totalPages
RelationshipRequestParams.totalPages.description:
Get the total number of items and pages in the pager.

**Only enable this if absolutely necessary as this is resource intensive.** Use the pagers
`prev/nextPage` to determine if there is a previous or a next page instead.

RelationshipRequestParams.trackedEntity.name: trackedEntity
RelationshipRequestParams.trackedEntity.description: Get relationships of the given trackedEntity.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.assignedUserM.name: assignedUserMode
TrackedEntityRequestParams.assignedUserM.description:
Get tracked entities with events assigned to users according to the specified user mode. By default,  
all events will be retrieved, regardless of whether a user is assigned.  
  
- When `assignedUserMode=ALL` or no `assignedUserMode`(default) is given, tracked entities are  
  returned irrespective of whether they contain events assigned to a user or not.  
  
- When `assignedUserMode=CURRENT`, tracked entities that have at least one event  
  assigned to the logged-in user will be returned.  
  
- When `assignedUserMode=ANY`,tracked entities that have at least one event with  
  an assigned user will be returned.  
  
- When `assignedUserMode=NONE`, tracked entities that have no event  
  that are assigned to any user will be returned.  
  
- When `assignedUserMode=PROVIDED`, tracked  
  entities that have any events assigned to the users specified in `assignedUsers` will be  
  returned. `assignedUsers` is required for this mode.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.assignedUsers.name: assignedUsers
TrackedEntityRequestParams.assignedUsers.description:
`<user1-uid>[,<user2-uid>...]`  
  
Get tracked entities with an event assigned to given user(s). Specifying `assignedUsers` is only  
valid if `assignedUserMode` is either `PROVIDED` or not specified.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.enrollmentEnr.name: enrollmentEnrolledAfter
TrackedEntityRequestParams.enrollmentEnr.description:
Get tracked entities that have at least one enrollment with an enrollment date after this date.  
This parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included  
in the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the start of the day is assumed.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.enrollmentEnr.name: enrollmentEnrolledBefore
TrackedEntityRequestParams.enrollmentEnr.description:
Get tracked entities that have at least one enrollment with an enrollment date before this date.  
This parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included  
in the response.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.filter.name: filter
TrackedEntityRequestParams.filter.description:
`<filter1>[,<filter2>...]`  
  
Get tracked entities matching the given filters attributes. A filter is a colon separated  
attribute UID with optional operator and value pairs.   
  
We differentiate between two types of  
operators: unary and binary. Unary operators don't require a value, while binary operators do.  
- Unary: `filter=H9IlTX2X6SL:null`  
- Binary: `filter=H9IlTX2X6SL:sw:A`  
  
Special characters like `+` must be percent-encoded (`%2B` instead of `+`). Characters like `:` and  
`,` in filter values must be escaped with `/`. Likewise, `/` needs to be escaped.  
Multiple operators are allowed for the same attribute, e.g.,  
`filter=AuPLng5hLbE:gt:438901703:lt:448901704`. Operators and values are  
case-insensitive. A user needs metadata read access to the attribute and data read access to the  
program (if the program is without registration) or the program stage (if the program is with  
registration).  
  
All of the following operators are supported regardless of the value type. Values are compared using  
text comparison unless stated otherwise. Integer and decimal value types are treated as Postgres  
integer and numeric data types for the specified operators.  
  
Valid binary operators are:  
- `eq` - equal to (uses integer/numeric semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ieq` - equal to  
- `ge` - greater than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `gt` - greater than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `le` - less than or equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `lt` - less than (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ne` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `neq` - not equal to (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `nieq` - not equal to  
- `in` - equal to one of the multiple values separated by semicolon ";" (uses integer/number semantics for integer/decimal value types)  
- `ilike` - is like  
- `like` - like (free text match)  
- `nilike` - not like  
- `nlike` - not like  
- `sw` - starts with  
- `ew` - ends with  
  
Right now all matches are case-insensitive so for example `eq` and `ieq` (`i` for `insensitive`)  
behave in the same way.  
  
Valid unary operators are:  
- `null` - has no value  
- `!null` - has a value

TrackedEntityRequestParams.followUp.name: followUp
TrackedEntityRequestParams.followUp.description: Get tracked entities that have at least one enrollment that is marked with follow-up.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.includeDelete.name: includeDeleted
TrackedEntityRequestParams.includeDelete.description: Include deleted tracked entities, enrollments, events and relationships in the response.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.order.name: order
TrackedEntityRequestParams.order.description:
`<propertyName1:sortDirection>[,<propertyName2:sortDirection>...]`  
  
Get tracked entities in given order. Tracked entities can be ordered by tracked entity attributes by  
passing a UID instead of a property name. This will order tracked entities by the values of the  
specified attribute not their UIDs. Tracked entities can also be ordered by the following  
case-sensitive properties  
  
* `createdAt`  
* `createdAtClient`  
* `enrolledAt`  
* `inactive`  
* `trackedEntity`  
* `updatedAt`  
* `updatedAtClient`  
  
Valid `sortDirection`s are `asc` and `desc`. `sortDirection` is case-insensitive. `sortDirection`  
defaults to `asc` for properties or UIDs without explicit `sortDirection` as in `order=createdAt`.  
  
Tracked entities are ordered by newest (internal id desc) by default meaning when no `order`  
parameter is provided.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.orgUnitMode.name: orgUnitMode
TrackedEntityRequestParams.orgUnitMode.description:
Get tracked entities using the given `orgUnitMode` and `program` parameters. If a  
`program` is provided, the ownership is determined with this program. When no program is provided,  
the registration organisation unit for the tracked entity would be used to determine ownership.  
  
- When `orgUnitMode=SELECTED`, `orgUnitMode=CHILDREN` or `orgUnitMode=DESCENDANTS`, the `orgUnit`  
  parameter is required to specify which tracked entities to return.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ALL` tracked entities will be downloaded irrespective of the organization  
  unit they are owned by. To use this parameter, the user needs the `Search Tracked  
  entity in all org units` authority.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ACCESSIBLE` tracked entities owned by any organisation unit in the  
  user's capture scope will be returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=CAPTURE` tracked entities that have an enrollment organisation unit  
  in the user's capture scope will be returned.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.orgUnits.name: orgUnits
TrackedEntityRequestParams.orgUnits.description:
`<orgUnit1-uid>[,<orgUnit2-uid>...]`  
  
Get tracked entities owned by given orgUnits relative to the `orgUnitMode` and  
`program` parameters. If a `program` is provided, the ownership is determined with this program. When  
no program is provided, the registration orgUnit for the tracked entity would be used to determine  
ownership.  
  
- When `orgUnitMode=SELECTED` - or no `orgUnitMode` is given (default) - the tracked entities  
  owned by the `orgUnits` are returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=CHILDREN` the tracked entities owned by the orgUnits or by the orgUnits  
  direct children is returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=DESCENDANTS` the tracked entities owned by the orgUnits or any of its  
  descendants are returned.  
- When `orgUnitMode=ALL`, `orgUnitMode=CAPTURE` or `orgUnitMode=ACCESSIBLE` the `orgUnits` parameter  
  is not allowed.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedAfter.name: updatedAfter
TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedAfter.description:
Get tracked entities that were updated after the given time. A tracked entity is considered  
updated if any of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships have been  
modified. The `updatedAt` property of the tracked entity reflects the latest time at which any  
of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships were modified. This  
parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included  
in the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the start of the day is assumed.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedBefore.name: updatedBefore
TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedBefore.description:
Get tracked entities that were updated before the given time. A tracked entity is considered  
updated if any of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships have been  
modified. The `updatedAt` property of the tracked entity reflects the latest time at which any  
of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships were modified. This  
parameter is inclusive, so results with the exact date and time specified will be included in  
the response.
Use a valid ISO8601 date _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD`_ or date-time _`YYYY[-]MM[-]DD'T'hh[:mm[:ss[.sss]]]`_ pattern.
When the time part is omitted the end of the day is assumed.

TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedWithin.name: updatedWithin
TrackedEntityRequestParams.updatedWithin.description:
Get tracked entities updated since the given ISO-8601 duration. A tracked entity is considered  
updated if any of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships have been  
modified. The `updatedAt` property of the tracked entity reflects the latest time at which any  
of its tracked entity attributes, enrollments, events or relationships were modified.
